_meta.note: arXiv 2605.14698 NeuroAtlas (KU Leuven / MIT): EEG foundation-model benchmark — seizure detection (7 cohorts + LODO), brain age (10 cohorts), BCI (18 datasets, 2 pooling protocols). Project pages kkontras.github.io/NeuroAtlas, biomedkuleuven.com/neuroatlas, github.com/kkontras/NeuroAtlas carry no extra numbers.

models.name: NeuroLM-VQ (NeuroLM VQ tokenizer encoder)
models._note: Label used in NeuroAtlas brain-age tables; may be the same frozen NeuroLM encoder as "NeuroLM" elsewhere in the paper (not stated).

benchmarks.name: NeuroAtlas Seizure Detection 7-cohort mean AUROC (linear probe)
benchmarks.description: Window-level seizure-detection AUROC of a frozen-encoder linear probe (5-fold subject-disjoint), averaged over 7 cohorts (TUSZ, Siena, SeizeIT1, CHB-MIT, SeizeIT2, Helsinki, Epilepsiae). Source: arXiv 2605.14698 (NeuroAtlas).

benchmarks.name: NeuroAtlas Seizure Detection 7-cohort mean balanced accuracy (linear probe)

benchmarks.name: NeuroAtlas Seizure Detection 7-cohort mean Event-Sens@FA AUC (linear probe)
